tasks.title: Touching an enemy hurts according to an explicit contact profile: always (normal ships), only while attacking (rammers), or with a blast that really hits you (explosive drones)
tasks.description:
See docs/plans/cmufs7ek60001nm2x6d0bt2et/3-plan.md §2.3.
- New global/components/contact_profile.gd (ContactProfile, a Node): modes NONE / COLLISION / RAMMING / EXPLOSIVE; setup(actor, hit_box, health); set_armed() toggles the ContactHitBox's monitorable and monitoring via set_deferred; signals contact_made(area: Area2D) and detonated(position: Vector2). EXPLOSIVE detonates on contact while armed and on the owner's death while armed (it listens to the health passed to setup()), never on death while unarmed.
- New global/components/contact_blast.gd (ContactBlast extends HitBox), built in code: detonate() spawns it into actor.get_parent() at actor.global_position with container.add_child.call_deferred (safe inside an area_entered callback), position applied in _enter_tree. Layer 256, mask 0, monitorable from the start, damage_type CONTACT. It stays alive for blast_frames physics frames (default 3, minimum 2) on its own counter (never create_timer), then queue_free()s. detonate() is idempotent.
Wiring:
- BaseEnemy resolves a scene-authored profile or creates a default COLLISION one, the same pattern as DefenseProfile.
- BaseEnemy.suspend_ai() arms it.
- Every legacy enemy keeps today's behaviour. The Bonus Drone (no ContactHitBox) resolves cleanly.
Tests: new tests/unit/test_contact_profile.gd (§4 row, including the engine pin that arming while already overlapping a player hurtbox registers exactly one hit); new tests/integration/test_contact_blast_damage.gd with a real player HurtBox (layer 128, mask 1281) and a real Health: an armed EXPLOSIVE fixture enemy killed with its blast (but not its contact box) overlapping the hurtbox lowers health by exactly blast_damage; unarmed lowers it by 0; outside blast_radius 0; detonating from inside an area_entered callback raises no error. Extend test_base_enemy.gd.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria:
- Every legacy enemy pin (test_base_enemy, the contact-damage and geometry gates, the station family, test_drone_interceptor) is green with no assertion changed.
- The blast lands in the owner's parent at the owner's position, survives the owner's free, damages a real player hurtbox, and is gone after blast_frames physics frames.
- Dying while unarmed does not detonate; detonate() is idempotent.
- Neither class writes velocity/rotation (single-writer gate green).
- Signal arity gate green. `bash /agent/verify.sh` passes; `scripts/check-test-leaks.sh` reports no leaks.
